pages.title: Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: Explain the whole system: major components, ownership boundaries, and the end-to-end data/control flow from document source to validated Pydantic output.
instructions: Identify ownership boundaries (which layer picks loaders, which sets page counts, which maps errors).
Map Extractor, Process, LLM, DocumentLoader hierarchy, completion handlers, splitters, batch job, eval subpackage, markdown converter.
Trace the data flow: source -> DocumentLoader.load -> _map_to_universal_format -> _build_messages -> LLM.request -> instructor/litellm -> Pydantic validation.

pages.title: Completion Strategies
pages.purpose: Explain FORBIDDEN/PAGINATE/CONCATENATE completion strategies: pagination per-page parallel extraction with conflict resolution, and concatenation continuation loop.
instructions: Cite tests covering strategies in tests/test_extractor.py.

Explain how completion_strategy is threaded from Extractor.extract into _extract and extract_with_strategy; PAGINATE path with make_all_fields_optional, ThreadPoolExecutor per-page, list merging via unique-key model merge, conflict dict structure and LLM conflict resolution; CONCATENATE path with raw_completion, json fence cleaning, max 3 retries; FORBIDDEN raising ExtractThinkerError on IncompleteOutputException/ValidationError/JSONDecodeError.

pages.title: Document Loaders
pages.purpose: Explain the DocumentLoader abstraction, capability detection, vision/pagination support, TTL caching, and the family of concrete loaders with their config objects and optional dependencies.
instructions: Cover the concrete loaders present and their declared formats; note vision-mode behaviors of rasterizing loaders.

Document DocumentLoader ABC: SUPPORTED_FORMATS + can_handle via extension and libmagic mime sniffing; load() contract; vision mode; convert_to_images via pypdfium2; URL screenshot via Playwright; TTL caching in CachedDocumentLoader; Config dataclasses; lazy optional imports with ImportError guidance.
Note extract_thinker/document_loader/document_loader.py defines shared rasterization; interceptor ABCs live in this package.

pages.title: Extractor Core
pages.purpose: Explain the Extractor: dependency validation, loader selection, universal content mapping, extraction vs classification vs batch paths, vision handling, interceptor seams, and error wrapping.
instructions: Cover classify(): text-only vs image-compare paths, confidence selection, Unknown fallback.

Cover extract()/extract_async(): dependency validation, list-of-sources merge with document separators, allow_vision fallback to DocumentLoaderLLMImage, _map_to_universal_format accepted shapes, set_skip_loading used by Process, error normalization to ExtractThinkerError, IncompleteOutputException under FORBIDDEN, vision BadRequestError reclassification via classify_vision_error.
Cover interceptor registration and the loader resolution order (primary loader, extension map, capability scan, DocumentLoaderData for lists/dicts).
Mention extract_batch gate (BATCH_SUPPORTED_MODELS, PYDANTIC_AI rejection).

pages.title: LLM Integration
pages.purpose: Explain the LLM wrapper: backends (litellm+instructor default, pydantic-ai optional), router/fallbacks, temperature, thinking budgets and token math, dynamic parsing, raw completion.
instructions: Cover LLMEngine.DEFAULT (litellm+instructor MD_JSON) vs PYDANTIC_AI lazy import; max_completion_tokens defaults and token_limit override; TIMEOUT and max_retries.

Explain request building, response_model handling, dynamic parsing via build_dynamic_prompt + extract_thinking_json, router support, thinking budget math (DEFAULT_PAGE_TOKENS, ratios, MIN/MAX budgets), set_thinking forcing temperature=1, raw_completion for concatenation.
Mention litellm.supports_reasoning gate and warning fallback when model lacks thinking.

pages.title: Process Orchestration: Classification, Splitting, Batch
pages.purpose: Explain multi-document workflows: Process classification/split/extract pipeline, classification strategies and consensus layers, tree classification, eager/lazy splitting with TextSplitter/ImageSplitter, doc group models, and BatchJob.
instructions: Cover BatchJob/OpenAI batch status polling and file cleanup.

Cover Process: loader registration conflicts (default vs per-file-type ValueError), classify with ClassificationStrategy over extractor_groups layers, threshold validation, classification tree traversal matching nodes by Classification.uuid, split() eager vs lazy (requires >=2 pages, lazy needs can_handle_paginate), extract() reusing split_classifications' extractor/extraction_contract precedence, asyncio usage patterns.
Cover splitters: Splitter ABC sliding two-page comparison via belongs_to_same_document, DocGroups2 aggregation into DocGroup page lists, TextSplitter vs ImageSplitter prompt approaches.

pages.title: Evaluation Framework
pages.purpose: Explain the eval subsystem: Evaluator, TeacherStudentEvaluator, datasets, metrics, field comparison, hallucination detection, cost tracking, reports, and CLI.
instructions: Cite tests/test_evaluator.py for representative behavior.

Explain Evaluator.evaluate loop: schema validation metrics, field comparison via FieldComparisonManager (ComparisonType EXACT/FUZZY/SEMANTIC/NUMERIC configs), optional hallucination detection (LLM vs HEURISTIC strategies), cost tracking via litellm completion_cost/token_counter, save_report.
Explain FileSystemDataset document/label pairing rules and CLI entry point extract_thinker-eval.
Explain TeacherStudentEvaluator comparison mode and report fields.

pages.title: Markdown Conversion
pages.purpose: Explain the MarkdownConverter subsystem that turns loaded pages into Markdown/structured page content using an LLM or basic conversion.
instructions: Explain to_markdown / to_markdown_structured flows, PageContent/ContentItem models, per-page parallelism, vision flag handling (recent bugfix context), basic non-LLM fallback path, and interaction with document loaders.
Keep it compact; this is a feature surface, not the core pipeline.

pages.title: Change Playbooks
pages.purpose: Focused change guides for representative maintenance tasks: adding a document loader, adding a completion strategy, adjusting thinking/token limits, extending classification, adding an LLM backend.
instructions: Derive concrete, evidence-backed steps for: adding a new DocumentLoader subclass (SUPPORTED_FORMATS, config dataclass, load() page-dict shape, registration in __init__.py __all__); adding an LLM backend to LLMEngine and branching in LLM.__init__/request; adding a CompletionStrategy enum member and handler implementation wired in Extractor._extract/extract_with_strategy; tuning thinking budgets/token constants; writing a Contract and running extraction.
Each guide must cite the exact code seams being touched.

pages.title: CI, Packaging, and Testing
pages.purpose: Explain how this package is built, tested, documented, and released, plus the test suite layout and env-var gating.
instructions: Cover config: pyproject (poetry, Python >=3.9,<3.14), requirements.txt vs requirements-docs.txt, .ruff.toml, .flake8, .pre-commit-config.yaml.

Cover test suite organization: tests/critical as CI gate; loader tests gated by env credentials (TESSERACT_PATH, AWS_*, AZURE_*, DOCUMENTAI_*, GEMINI_API_KEY etc.); contract classes in tests/models; test fixtures layout.
Cover workflow.yml: critical tests on Python 3.10 with GROQ_API_KEY, poetry install, poetry add pypdf step, version matrix job; documentation.yml mkdocs gh-deploy; manual-publish.yml PyPI flow.
Do not invent deployment targets beyond what workflows show.

pages.title: Quickstart
pages.purpose: Practical onboarding: install, env setup, first extraction, first classification, running the test suite, and pointers to deeper pages.
instructions: Cite extract_thinker/__init__.py, pyproject.toml, README.md, tests/critical.
Cover install (pip/poetry), provider API keys via .env (OPENAI_API_KEY etc.), minimal Extractor+Contract example from README, classification example, and how to run tests.
State only what the repo establishes; do not invent deployment details.
